operations.title: Compile the package's C#
operations.summary: Compile every assembly under *source*, editor and player builds, without the optional packages and (given a reference project) with them.

source.description: The folder holding the package's `.asmdef` files; default: this checkout's own package (`com.m3trik.unitytk/`).

editor.description: The editor whose compiler and assemblies to use: a Unity executable or an installed version (`"6000.3.10f1"`); default: the newest installed.

reference_project.description: A project an editor imported with the URP, Input System and XR Interaction Toolkit packages, whose `Library/ScriptAssemblies` the package half compiles against; default, for the package itself (no *source*): the owned project of *editor* once imported; without one, only the half without them is built.

tests.description: Compile the package's test assemblies too, in the editor build with the packages, where the reference project holds the Test Framework (they are Editor-only and need its assemblies and NUnit); False leaves them out, a faster loop that cannot see a broken test file.

operations.title: Build the owned test and demo project
operations.summary: Build the owned project for *editor* (the newest when `None`) and *pipeline*, or refresh it: made once by Unity's CLI from the editor's template, its manifest naming this checkout's package every time.

key.description: Another project of its own beside the owned one (`folder`), built and refreshed alike: a run that must not share the owned project builds its own.

replacements.description: Per sample, a folder of files delivered in place of its own (`import_samples`).

operations.title: Install unitytk in a Unity project
operations.summary: Install unitytk's package in *project*: one line in its manifest.
